summary: Red Violet, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten public offering of 1,666,667 shares of common stock at $60.00 per share, with an over-allotment option of 250,000 shares. The offering is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. Joint bookrunning managers are Raymond James and Needham Company; co-managers are B. Riley Securities and Craig-Hallum. Proceeds before expenses are $95,000,019. The last sale price was $68.28, reflecting a discount. This is a standard equity offering with no special-situation classification.
